title: Daily digest: Economist Parakala Prabhakar to particip | Ponnam Urges Graduates to Enroll for MLC | Voting in first phase of panchayat polls | Elon Musk giving tops $445 million in US | Docu film accuses Modi, Adani of corrupt
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle / LiveMint / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: Economist Parakala Prabhakar to participate in protest against SIR in Hyderabad on October 24.
Ponnam Urges Graduates to Enroll for MLC Polls by Nov. 6.
Voting in first phase of panchayat polls concludes in Rajasthan.
Elon Musk giving tops $445 million in US midterm election push for GOP.
Docu film accuses that Modi, Adani of corruption; 24 issued notices.
bullets_ur: Maeeshat daan Parakala Prabhakar 24 October ko Hyderabad mein SIR ke khilaf ehtijaj mein shirkat karenge
Ponnam ne Enroll ko MLC Polls ke liye Nov. 6 ke zariye Graduates par zoor diya.
Rajasthan mein panchayat chunaav ke pehle daur ki rai dahi mukammal hui
US midterm intikhabat: GOP ke liye Elon Musk ki funding $445 million se tajawuz kar gayi.
Documentary film ne Modi, Adani par corruption ka ilzaam lagaya; 24 notices jari kiye
